idea-plugin.name: WaitLingo
idea-plugin.description:
WaitLingo helps you learn English while working in your IDE.

It shows short English-Turkish word pairs in the status bar and lets you open a lightweight popup with example sentences.

The goal is to turn small waiting moments in the IDE into calm, low-friction vocabulary practice.

  • English-Turkish vocabulary cards
  • Status bar word rotation
  • Two example sentences for every word
  • Lightweight popup UI
  • Works fully offline
  • No telemetry
  • No account required
  • No network request
idea-plugin.change-notes:
WaitLingo 0.1.3

Practice developer vocabulary while coding, with better recall and IDE compatibility.

  • Added a recall step that hides the meaning after a word has been opened once.
  • Added an editor context action to learn selected terms and save personal words locally.
  • Improved spaced repetition so words scheduled for later are not rotated early.
  • Fixed a status bar painting crash during the word transition animation.
  • Verified compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2.6 and 2026.2.3.
